title: ARPANET Host to Host Access and Disengagement Measurements
authors_or_bodies: National Telecommunications and Information Administration / Institute for Telecommunication Sciences

fixity.scan_notes: Relevant VDH diagram/page visually inspected during research.

redistribution_notes: Government-report status should be confirmed for any local mirror; canonical NTIA access is preferred.

claims_extracted.claim: The documented DOCB TIP to PDP-11 Very Distant Host path used special interfaces and VDH software at both machines with BSC-style synchronization/control.
claims_extracted.locator: VDH hardware/path discussion and diagram, report page around the VDH section; visually verified

claims_extracted.claim: The VDH data path operated at 50 kbit/s full duplex with a Bell 303 modem at each end.
The two Bell 303 units in this installation were connected over almost 1800 feet using two twisted pairs of shielded cable within the Radio Building.
claims_extracted.notes: This is one concrete local VDH installation, not a universal ARPANET Bell 303 wiring rule.

notes: Exceptional site-level physical evidence connecting abstract VDH/1822 documentation to actual Bell 303 hardware and cable plant.
